## Architecture Guidance Metadata

```yaml
guidance_id: 'GUID-SEC-<CAPABILITY>-CAP-DESC-0.N.NN'
guidance_name: '{security_capability_name} Capability Descriptions'
guidance_type: 'capability-descriptions'
parent_vision: '<GUID-SEC-*-VISION-0.N.NN>'
adm_phase: 'Phase A-B'
category: 'security'
version: '0.1.0'
status: 'draft'
applicability: 'enterprise'
tags: ['security', '<capability-tag>', 'capability-descriptions', 'phase-a', 'phase-b']
author: '<Author Name>'
```

---

> **TOGAF ADM Note — Phase A–B**: This document provides narrative descriptions of each L2 capability area within the {security_capability_name} domain. It is a companion to the Capability Map and supports both Architecture Vision (Phase A) and Business Architecture (Phase B) elaboration.
>
> **This content does NOT define Architecture Building Blocks (ABBs).** Capability descriptions express *what* the capability does and *why* it matters — not *how* it is implemented. ABBs are defined in the Composite ABB document for this domain.
